description: Encrypted budget snapshots (BENC-format .benc files) that the hosted budget app loads. The household password decrypts them.
Plaintext bank-statement downloads used as budget-etl input. Source records behind the budget snapshots.
Print app sidecar state (plain JSON in a .commons-print directory inside the owner's media folder). Bookmarks and annotations.
Audio app sidecar state (plain JSON in a .commons-audio directory inside the owner's media folder). Listening positions.

The commons.systems git repository, including the intention graph under intentions/. The git verify confirms the off-machine copy: a passing origin remote (GitHub) is the redundant mirror, so min_copies is 1 (the local checkout) rather than a second on-disk clone.
